rationale: The assistant correctly decoded E:15 on the SMV4HTX31E as the anti-flood float, advised isolating power and water, and adapted sensibly to the customer's integrated/glued-plinth constraints and 'tablets only, no foam' evidence without inventing anything. It acknowledged 'there's a real leak somewhere' and pointed to an engineer / Bosch fixed-price repair, but softened this to 'if it keeps coming back' and encouraged running wash cycles on a machine with a known leak plus DIY extraction (cutting the silicone), which sits against the ground-truth boundary of not running it and leaving pull-out to an engineer. No part was recommended and uncertainty about the leak source was appropriately kept open.
